panels.title: Heartbeat freshness per cohort
panels.description: Per 1-minute bucket: distinct clients that sent a heartbeat / distinct clients heard from. The exact 60-second freshness ratio is the Prometheus gauge fleetpulse_heartbeat_freshness_ratio; this panel is the same events, sliced through ClickHouse.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(ts, '1m') AS time,
  cohort,
  uniqExactIf(client_id, type = 'heartbeat') / uniqExact(client_id) AS freshness
FROM fleetpulse.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time, cohort
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Capture completeness per cohort (mean over sessions)
panels.description: Mean over sessions of distinct sequence numbers received / expected_event_count, read from the session_capture_progress materialized view. Mirrors fleetpulse_capture_completeness_ratio.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfMinute(last_seen) AS time,
  cohort,
  avg(least(received / nullIf(expected, 0), 1.0)) AS completeness
FROM
(
  SELECT
    cohort,
    session_id,
    uniqExactMerge(sequences) AS received,
    maxMerge(expected_events) AS expected,
    maxMerge(last_seen) AS last_seen
  FROM fleetpulse.session_capture_progress
  GROUP BY cohort, session_id
)
GROUP BY time, cohort
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Mapping availability (downstream dependency)
panels.description: Trailing-window success ratio of capture-enrichment calls to the Workflow Mapping stub, written by the worker to mapping_results. Not derived from fleet events; see docs/signals.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(ts, '1m') AS time,
  countIf(success = 1) / count() AS availability
FROM fleetpulse.mapping_results
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Dark cohort heartbeat volume (${version})
panels.description: Heartbeats per minute for the version selected in the dashboard variable. WITH FILL STEP 60 emits explicit zero rows, so a cohort that goes silent shows a line dropping to 0 rather than a gap.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(ts, '1m') AS time,
  count() AS heartbeats
FROM fleetpulse.events
WHERE type = 'heartbeat' AND version = '${version}' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time WITH FILL STEP 60

panels.title: 2.6.0-beta goes dark (hardcoded demo cohort)
panels.description: The runbook scenario pinned to 2.6.0-beta so it is visible even when the dashboard variable points elsewhere. Start the simulator with --kill-cohort=2.6.0-beta and this panel drops to zero about two minutes in.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(ts, '1m') AS time,
  count() AS heartbeats
FROM fleetpulse.events
WHERE type = 'heartbeat' AND version = '2.6.0-beta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time WITH FILL STEP 60

panels.title: Freshness now vs 5 minutes ago
panels.description: Per-cohort comparison used in the runbook: freshness_now uses the trailing 60 seconds, freshness_5m_ago uses [now-6m, now-5m). A silent cohort's now column collapses to 0 while the 5m-ago column stays healthy.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  cohort,
  uniqExactIf(client_id, type = 'heartbeat' AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 60 SECOND) / uniqExact(client_id) AS freshness_now,
  uniqExactIf(client_id, type = 'heartbeat' AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 360 SECOND AND ts < now() - INTERVAL 300 SECOND) / uniqExact(client_id) AS freshness_5m_ago
FROM fleetpulse.events
WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY cohort
